cards.title: Terminate with Corpus Approach

exchange.speaker: Approach
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Approach, no observed traffic between you and the Ingleside Airport, change to advisory frequency is approved.

cards.detail: Approach may instead report traffic between you and the Rockport Airport when arriving from the south or east.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 55–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 85–93.

cards.title: Self-announce on Ingleside CTAF

radio.script: “Ingleside Traffic, <callsign>, <direction and distance from airfield> at <altitude>, inbound for a left overhead RWY {to.runway}, Ingleside Traffic.”

cards.detail: Pattern calls follow the Aransas County format: initial, numbers, left crosswind, left base. Pattern is left-hand at 800', break at 1,000'. The CTAF call wording is assumed from Aransas County; check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 55–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 85–93.
